interpretations: Count each constructor’s rows in `constructorStandings`, including constructors with zero rows when calculating the average across all constructors; show the 10 largest positive differences from that average, with constructor ID, nationality, count, and difference.

Count each constructor’s rows in `constructorStandings` and calculate the average only across constructors with at least one standings row; show the 10 largest positive differences from that average, with constructor ID, nationality, count, and difference.
queries:
WITH standing_counts AS (
    SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS standing_count
    FROM constructors AS c
    LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs
        ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
    GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality
),
average_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(standing_count) AS avg_count
    FROM standing_counts
)
SELECT sc.constructorId,
       sc.nationality,
       sc.standing_count,
       sc.standing_count - ac.avg_count AS difference
FROM standing_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
WHERE sc.standing_count > ac.avg_count
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH standings_counts AS (
    SELECT constructorId, COUNT(*) AS standings_count
    FROM constructorStandings
    GROUP BY constructorId
),
average_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(standings_count) AS avg_standings_count
    FROM standings_counts
)
SELECT
    c.constructorId,
    c.nationality,
    sc.standings_count,
    sc.standings_count - a.avg_standings_count AS difference
FROM standings_counts AS sc
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = sc.constructorId
CROSS JOIN average_count AS a
WHERE sc.standings_count > a.avg_standings_count
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
